title: The Whispering Palms Lotus Mandap
summary: A sacred water-sanctuary mandap featuring 40,000 hand-threaded white rajnigandha strands and floating pink lotus blossoms.
designConcept: Drawing inspiration from traditional Dravidian stone temple geometry and pristine Kerala lotus ponds, we erected an open-air stone-textured octagonal pavilion crowned by a cascading floral dome. Natural morning sunlight filtered through the delicate tuberose strings, casting celestial shadows across the sacred agni kund.
highlight: Bespoke acoustic water-curtain and hand-hammered temple bells

title: The Celestial Velvet Gala Reception
summary: An architectural symphony in midnight emerald, fluted champagne arches, and 2,000 hanging crystal prisms.
designConcept: For an evening of black-tie sophistication, we transformed a 10,000 sq ft ballroom into an enchanted winter nocturnal garden. Fluted curved stage arches finished in matte oyster-white provided deep optical dimension, flanked by six-foot crystal candelabras and lush arrangements of black baccara roses and white orchids.
highlight: Mirrored walkway with submerged fiber-optic constellation points

title: The Saffron Courtyard Mehendi & Haldi
summary: A sensory celebration bathed in fresh marigold cascades, hand-blocked Jaipur textiles, and artisanal brass urlis.
designConcept: Set under century-old rain trees, this Haldi and Mehendi concept fused vintage Karnataka courtyard warmth with joyful Rajasthani vibrancy. We draped five distinct shades of yellow and saffron marigolds into ten-meter suspended water-fountains, creating joyous photo backdrops and a fragrant canopy for the couple's ceremonial ritual.
highlight: Custom artisanal brass swing adorned with 10,000 jasmine blossoms

title: Suspended Botanical Cloud Canopy
summary: Weightless aerial clouds of gypsophila, Dutch hydrangea, and pale eucalyptus suspended across a glasshouse conservatory.
designConcept: Conceived as an ethereal floating dreamscape, our structural rigging team suspended fifteen organic botanical clouds directly beneath the glass ceiling. At dusk, concealed warm micro-beams illuminated each cluster from within, casting a diffused, celestial glow over long candlelit banquet tables.

title: The Olive & Amber Courtyard Vows
summary: An intimate micro-wedding for 75 cherished guests featuring heirloom stoneware, natural linen, and hand-dipped beeswax tapers.
designConcept: For this deeply personal ceremony, every tactile surface was treated with artisanal reverence. We erected an asymmetric wild-rose bower framed against an ancient banyan tree. Guests dined at two continuous fifty-foot teak tables adorned with hand-calligraphed linen napkins and individual rosemary bouquets.
highlight: Hand-dipped 100% natural beeswax tapers with personalized wax seal place cards

title: The Luminary Leadership Gala
summary: A sculptural, architectural stage and immersive gala environment celebrating corporate excellence.
designConcept: Balancing institutional gravitas with contemporary artistic restraint, we engineered a monolithic geometric backdrop featuring matte anthracite panels accented by recessed warm architectural lighting strips and floating brushed bronze award pedestals.
highlight: Glare-free matte finish backdrops engineered specifically for broadcast cameras

title: The Azure Shoreline Beach Mandap
summary: A minimalist bamboo and sheer organza sanctuary framing the Arabian Sea sunset.
designConcept: To honor the infinite horizon of the ocean, we designed an ultra-minimalist coastal mandap using sun-bleached driftwood timber, floating oyster-white organza that moved gently with sea breezes, and native pampas grass interwoven with blush proteas and white gardenias.
highlight: Wind-engineered structural anchoring with silent acoustic fabric weighting

title: The Mirage Mirror Sangeet Stage
summary: An infinity reflective runway, kinetic gold lighting cages, and cascading black amaranthus.
designConcept: Conceived for an unforgettable night of music and choreography, this design featured a 40-foot mirrored black dance floor that reflected thousands of warm overhead tungsten bulbs. The stage featured rotating gilded geometric frames interwoven with dried pampas and preserved dark botanicals.
highlight: Custom high-load tempered mirror dance floor with non-slip treatment
